claims.evidence: Brand and model names are not legible in the photos, and the seller's business status is not shown.
Tread depth and remaining usable life are listed as not shown in the witness report.
History of repairs or patches is not shown in the photos.
Bulges are not addressed in the witness report and are not clearly visible in stack photos.
Manufacture date or age of the tires is not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining usable life are unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip of the tread on multiple tires, ideally with a tread depth gauge
risks.if_unproven: price as worn-out or scrap tires

risks.risk: Tires may not hold air or may have punctures
risks.proof: Video of tires being inflated or held underwater to reveal leaks

risks.risk: Age and manufacture date unknown; rubber may be dried out or expired
risks.proof: Photo of the DOT code on the sidewall
risks.if_unproven: price as aged rubber with limited life

risks.risk: Undisclosed repairs, patches, or internal damage
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of the inner liner and full tire surface

risks.risk: Exact size and specifications unknown, limiting resale
risks.proof: Clear photo of sidewall markings showing size and load/speed rating

risks.risk: Brand and origin cannot be confirmed as Belgium tires
risks.proof: Legible photo of the brand and model name on the sidewall
risks.if_unproven: price as unbranded or unknown origin tires

proof_requests: Close-up tread photos with depth gauge
Sidewall branding and size marking photos
Video of inflation or leak test
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as used car tires, so a worst-case price can be set immediately; unverified condition claims only determine how much proof could raise the price.
